CISCE: Class 10
Key Points: Distribution of Population in India
Dense population
→ Northern plains (Ganga–Brahmaputra region).
Highest density (2011)
→ Bihar; also high in West Bengal & Kerala.
Sparse population
→ Himalayan region, Thar Desert, North-East hills.
Kerala
→ Most densely populated state in South India.
Population density
= Number of persons per sq. km.
